subject: POC plan & risk tracker - Stellar Commerce
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@stellarcommerce.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: POC scope + success criteria (next steps)

Hi Alex - great chat today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the 2-week POC we talked about: 

Scope / success criteria:
- Integrate Redwood Hosted API for product description generation on two flows (checkout upsell and email summaries).
- Latency: p50 < 350ms on 512 token sequences for the checkout flow; p95 < 800ms for the email summary flow.
- Cost target: average token cost <= $0.0018 for these evaluation workloads.
- Quality: 85%+ pass rate on your internal relevance rubric (sample size = 100 prompts).

Evaluation plan & timeline:
- Week of Aug 24: access & ingestion (sample data + test prompts).
- Aug 26-29: integration + smoke tests.
- Sep 1-4: run evaluation set, collect metrics and logs.
- Sep 7: sync to review results and next steps.

Ownership / contacts:
- Stellar technical lead: TBD (can you confirm who will own integration?).
- Redwood POC lead: Marissa Cole (me) - product/ops coordination.
- Redwood engineering lead (technical escalations): Rishi Malhotra (cc).

Risks we flagged on the call:
- Streaming response reliability for very low-latency checkout paths.
- KV/prefix caching behavior with your customization layer.

Attachments:
- I attached a draft POC risk tracker (Stellar_POC_Risk_Tracker_v1.xlsx) - please review and add any items on your side.

Please confirm the technical owner and whether the proposed timeline works. If anything here misses the mark, tell me and I'll update.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@stellarcommerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -0700

Thanks Marissa - this looks good. Confirming the timeline works for us. A few quick notes: 

- Technical lead will be Ethan Brown (ethan.brown@stellarcommerce.com) - looped in on this thread.
- One additional success criterion: generated descriptions must not hallucinate product attributes (we'll sample 50 items).
- We'll aim to have test data and API keys ready by Aug 24.

I'll review the risk tracker and add items from our infra team. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@stellarcommerce.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2026 15:00:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: POC scope + risk tracker - action items for eng (internal)

Hi team - forwarding the confirmed scope from Stellar. Key asks for engineering: 

1) Streaming reliability: Alex called out the checkout path as most sensitive. Can we confirm current streaming SLA and any known regressions for sub-350ms p50?
2) KV/prefix caching: need guidance on whether their customization layer (they use an in-process cache) will conflict with Redwood's prefix caching. Any config recommendations?
3) Contingency plan for hallucination check (we'll provide a sample set): can we run a lightweight post-filter script or flagging mechanism during the POC?

I attached the current risk tracker (Stellar_POC_Risk_Tracker_v1.xlsx) - please add rows for each item and owners. Rishi - can you own the engineering side? Dev - can you assess feasibility and ETA for the quick mitigations above?

Goal: have eng plan + owners by EOD Mon Aug 16 so we can lock the kickoff on Aug 24.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Ethan Brown <ethan.brown@stellarcommerce.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@stellarcommerce.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Blocking: streaming responses failing on staging (logs attached)

Marissa / team - we started an initial integration test this morning and hit a blocking issue: streaming responses intermittently fail with an EOF error during the checkout flow. Attached a short log and a recording of the failed request ids. This blocks our ability to run the latency measurement and the quality checks.

Error summary:
- Endpoint: /v1/generate/stream
- Symptoms: connection closed mid-stream; client shows EOF and partial token output.
- Frequency: ~1 in 6 requests during our run (repro on staging).

I've attached streaming-error.log with the request ids and timestamps. Can you triage and advise on a mitigation path? If we can't get a short-term workaround, we'll have to delay the POC start.

Thanks,
Ethan Brown
Platform Engineer | Stellar Commerce
ethan.brown@stellarcommerce.com

Attachment: streaming-error.log

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Brown <ethan.brown@stellarcommerce.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@stellarcommerce.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2026 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Blocking: streaming responses failing on staging - RED-2145 (next steps)

Hi all - thanks for the heads up, Ethan. I created an engineering ticket (RED-2145) and moved the logs to the ticket workspace: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-2145. Summary and immediate mitigation plan below: 

1) Triage (today, Aditya + Dev): reproduce on staging with your request ids and capture full tcp traces.
2) Short-term mitigation (within 24-48 hrs): if the issue is connection handling we can switch the checkout flow to batched non-streaming responses (slightly higher p50 but reliable). Dev - can you scope the effort to add a toggle and ETA?
3) Longer-term fix (engineers): root cause and patch to streaming transport. Target ETA EOD next week.
4) Escalation: Rishi will keep engineering leadership looped if we observe customer-impacting regression during the POC window.

Action items: 
- Marissa: update Stellar's risk tracker with RED-2145 and the mitigation plan (you own customer comms).
- Dev: scope toggle to disable streaming per-client and provide ETA.
- Rishi: own engineering updates and weekly status.

Ethan/Alex - apologies for the disruption. If you prefer we can delay the kickoff to Sep 1 while we stabilize streaming, but we think the toggle mitigates risk and keeps you on the original timeline. Please let us know which you prefer.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Director, Engineering Operations | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

Attachment: ENG-RED-2145-jira-link.txt
